hero.title: What is MythoFame
hero.description:
A fan community for MythoLogic Interactive
Building and sharing what players create

intro.title: Made by fans, for fans
intro.description: MythoFame is a home for community-made content for MythoLogic Interactive games, with a special focus on Superfighters Deluxe. We bring creations together so they are easier to discover, enjoy, and share with other players.

hero.title: A place for creations of every kind
hero.description: We make far more than one kind of thing. Whether you are looking for something new to play or have a creation of your own to share, you can upload it here.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: New ways to play and overhaul the game.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Fresh campaigns, custom modes, and places to battle.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description: Tools, game modes, and ideas to enhance the game.

resources.title: Resources & More
resources.description: Textures, sounds, experiments, and all the other things.

community.title: Built with passion
community.description:
MythoFame is made by passionate contributors who want to leave something.
Every creation helps keep the community creative, welcoming, and full of new things to explore.

hero.description:
Superfighters Redux is an open-source mod for Superfighters Deluxe.
It adds new content and tweaks mechanics for a more engaging game experience.

skins.title: Cosmetics
skins.description:
Explore a plethora of new items and colors you can equip.
Some skins even feature a tertiary color option.

weapons.title: Weapons
weapons.description:
Discover tons of new weapons and makeshift items.
Some weapons feature even unique mechanics and effects.

more.title: Much More
more.description:
Enjoy new music, sounds, triggers, effects, items
and various other enhancements.

sfdct.description:
Superfighters Custom is an addon for Superfighters Deluxe.
It adds and tweaks some features while mantaining compatibility with vanilla-SFD.
Meaning that a player can join a normal SFD server with SFDCT and vice-versa.

hero.title: Tokenizer
hero.description: Use this tool to generate 'official' tokens used to lock map files.
